test_title: PYST 2: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Arrange the passage correctly:**
(1) He allowed the mixture to steep for several minutes in order to create a strong, flavorful brew.
(2) He filled the electric kettle with clean water carefully and put it safely on the stove.
(3) Once the water had boiled, he poured measured quantities of tea leaves and sugar into it.
(4) And so, he poured the boiling tea into a scrubbed ceramic mug and served it hot.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct sequence for the sentences is **2 - 3 - 1 - 4**, as it logically arranges the actions to describe the process of tea preparation.
 
• **Sentence 2** is the first sentence because it introduces the initial step of filling the kettle:
 
 
• "He filled the electric kettle with clean water carefully and put it safely on the stove."</sp
